title: 4 maps, and I hope a bit of fun, FREE to play for anyone who wanna try it!
author: LostRequirement4828
selftext:
I intend to make this into a multiplayer game based on a rank system, mechanics gonna change along the way.

[https://vengeful180-dot.github.io/Need4Space/](https://vengeful180-dot.github.io/Need4Space/)

comments.author: Heavy_Extent_3863
comments.body: It looks insane! I don't care how much of AI you used. It looks amazing. Will test play it.

replies.author: LostRequirement4828
replies.body: Thanks, that means a lot! I used AI, yes, but it was a lot of manual work too.

replies.author: Heavy_Extent_3863
replies.body: But... The name is terrible and the logo too. You should put more energy in it. I'm excited to play it. I really hope you designed the sound with all your effort.

replies.author: LostRequirement4828
replies.body: Haha, I found the name funny, It's not the final name unless it becomes a meme. It was mostly a palceholder. It's still early so a lot of things will get polished out.

comments.author: Creepy-Pain3449
comments.body: Did you make the models yourself?

replies.author: LostRequirement4828
replies.body: Yea, the models are all done in blender
